author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a new hand home, counting three knocks, steps and leaps, long notes and a tune that comes back, with an old French moonlight song.

classes.title: Thumb on D, by the moon
classes.goal: Hear the song and rest five fingers on the five keys from D to A.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys; help your child rest the thumb on D, between them.
classes.childAction: Put your thumb on D, in the middle of two black keys.
classes.bridge: D sits snug between the two black keys; the other fingers line up to its right.

intro.caption: Sway slowly, like moonlight
intro.parentCue: then find D, between the two black keys

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers together, one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding a new hand home from D.

classes.title: Knock, knock, knock
classes.goal: Play the first line: three knocks on F, then a climb up and back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing 'three' at once: knock, knock, knock

classes.parentPrompt: Knock three times on the piano lid together, then play the three Fs.
classes.childAction: Finger 3 knocks F three times, then climbs to A and back.
classes.bridge: Three knocks on the friend's door, then tiptoe up the steps and wait.

intro.caption: Knock, knock, knock
intro.parentCue: Knock three times on the lid together

games.caption: Knock, knock, knock, then climb
games.parentCue: Count one, two, three on the Fs

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing and playing three.

classes.title: Skip up, step home
classes.goal: Play the second line: skip from F up to A, then step down home to F.

mathTarget.parentLine: Jumping over one key, then walking back next door

classes.parentPrompt: Point to G and say 'skip over it', then 'step, step' on the way home.
classes.childAction: Play F, skip to A, then G, G, home to F.
classes.bridge: A skip hops over a key like a puddle; a step goes next door.

intro.caption: Skip up, step home
intro.parentCue: Point to G: this is the key we skip

games.caption: F, skip to A, step home

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling a step from a skip.

classes.title: The knock tune comes back
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and spot the tune that returns three times.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tune comes back, with a different part in the middle

classes.parentPrompt: Each time the knock tune starts, hold up one more finger and count aloud.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and say the number each time the knocks return.
classes.bridge: Knock tune, knock tune, a new middle part, then the knock tune again.

intro.caption: The knock tune comes back
intro.parentCue: Hold up a finger each time the knocks return

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the part of a song that returns.

classes.title: Candle out: a big leap
classes.goal: Practise the middle line slowly, with its big leap from G down to D.

mathTarget.parentLine: Jumping far, from one end of the hand to the other

classes.parentPrompt: Show finger 4 on G and the thumb on D; you play the last low C.
classes.childAction: Four Gs, then the thumb leaps down to D.
classes.bridge: The candle goes out: the tune jumps down from G to D, then walks lower.

intro.caption: Watch slowly
intro.parentCue: Show your child finger 4 and the thumb

games.caption: G, G, G, G, leap to D
games.parentCue: Say 'leap!' as the thumb plays D

games.caption: Walk down: G, F, E, D
games.parentCue: Then you play the low C to finish

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a big leap with your fingers.

classes.title: Hold the moon note
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and hold each long note for its full count.

mathTarget.parentLine: Some notes last two beats, the last one lasts four

classes.parentPrompt: Count the long notes aloud: 'one, two' for A and G, 'one, two, three, four' for F.
classes.childAction: Keep your finger down on long notes while you count.
classes.bridge: Long notes are the moon resting: press, keep holding, and count.

intro.caption: Hold the moon note
intro.parentCue: Count the long notes out loud together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: holding long notes for their full count.

classes.title: Moon up high
classes.goal: Move the hand to a higher D and play the song with the same fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song and fingers, moved to a higher home

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child find the next D to the right, then ask which sounds nicer.
classes.childAction: Move your thumb up to high D and play the same notes.
classes.bridge: Same hand shape, a new house to the right, up near the moon.

intro.caption: Watch: same song, up high
intro.parentCue: Find the next two black keys to the right

games.caption: Knock, knock, knock, up high
games.parentCue: Whisper the words, like a night-time secret

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: moving a song to a new place.

classes.title: Walk in the moonlight
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your playing in time with the music

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the words along and nod on each beat; if a note slips, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play with the music and keep going to the end.
classes.bridge: Walk with the music to the friend's door, step by step.

intro.caption: Play along
intro.parentCue: Sing the words softly with your child

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping in time with the music.

classes.title: Moonlight concert
classes.goal: Play the whole song softly for teddy, from first note to last.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song has a start, a middle and an end

classes.parentPrompt: Dim the lights a little, sit teddy in front, then clap and bow together.
classes.childAction: Bow, play softly for teddy, then bow again.
classes.bridge: Night-time music is soft, like moonlight on the keys.

intro.caption: Play the whole song!
intro.parentCue: Sit teddy in front and announce the song

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song softly, start to end.
